description: This file defines the SourceFactory class, which provides a method to load and instantiate source connector classes based on a string identifier. It handles dynamic class loading, sanitization of input, and initialization of source instances for the SuiteCRM project.

classes.name: SourceFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for dynamically loading and instantiating source connector classes based on a string identifier, with optional initialization.

methods.name: getSource
methods.description: Loads and returns an instance of a source connector class specified by the input string, with optional initialization, handling security checks and class instantiation.
